name: Taskade
description: Taskade is a collaborative task management and mind mapping tool designed to help teams organize, plan, and execute projects efficiently. It offers features such as real-time collaboration, task assignments, and project templates to streamline workflows.

events.d: Initiate a fresh project in your workspace for efficient team collaboration and organization.
Update a task's content within a project.
Get a complete overview of all your workspaces.
Create one or more tasks or subtasks in a project and place them before or after an existing task.
Retrieve a list of folders within a Taskade workspace to help organize and manage tasks.
Collect all projects from a chosen folder in Taskade.
Change the status of a task in a project.
Lists all tasks in a specified project.
